notes:
• With a hardware keyboard, Enter in the message box sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line, and ⌘↩ (Ctrl+Enter on Android) queues the message while the agent works, like in Conductor, or sends it otherwise. On iPad the suggestion bar of a hardware keyboard no longer covers the bottom of the message box.
• When a chat has an unsent draft on the Mac, the message about it now has an "Overwrite" button: it clears the draft in Conductor and sends your message instead. iPhone and Android alike.
• iPad: the sidebar stays open when you leave the app and come back.
